name: Banh dau xanh
summary: A gift cake of mung bean cooked with pork, sweet, salty, and rich, dried until crisp and eaten with hot tea. A meatless cake is made too.
origin: Hội An, on the 16 Apr 2024 city page, which also calls it a childhood snack for people who live there.
taste: The pork filling is sweet, salty, and rich on the 16 Apr 2024 page. The dried cake is crisp. Eat it with hot tea.
howToEat: Eat the dried cake with a cup of hot tea. Ask for the meatless cake if you do not eat pork.
seoTitle: Banh dau xanh — Hoi An mung-bean cake
seoDescription: Bánh đậu xanh Hội An has a pork and mung-bean filling, or a meatless cake, eaten with hot tea.
